- Finish the existing browser-based dodgeball game into a polished, playable game.

## Requirements
- Proceed without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected profile persistence, gameplay achievement call sites, arcade rendering, and relevant UI styles.
- Confirmed progression and shop systems are incomplete: saved unlocks are discarded, `unlock()` is a no-op, and currency has no earning implementation.

### Active
- Investigate match rewards and progression before implementing profile, achievement, shop, and arcade-tab fixes.
- Complete and play-test the game, then capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining match-flow code and pickup handling for reward opportunities.
2. Implement saved character unlocks, achievement rewards, coin earning/spending, and character/upgrade purchases.
3. Add working upgrades and trophies tabs using existing data and styles.
4. Run and play-test the game; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
5. Summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: profile persistence, character and upgrade data, achievements, shared state.
- `game-play.js`: match flow, earnings display, stats, achievement call sites, no-op `unlock`.
- `game-ui.js`: arcade/shop rendering, achievement toast helper, purchase handlers, boot.
- `game-fx.js`: hit and catch stats and achievement triggers.
- `index.html`: arcade tab markup and game screens.
- `style.css`: existing upgrades, character, and trophy card styles.

## Important Context
- `loadProfile()` in `game.js` currently sets `unlocked` to every character, regardless of saved profile.
- `unlock(id)` in `game-play.js` returns without doing anything, despite multiple achievement call sites; `game-ui.js` already has an achievement toast helper.
- `game-ui.js` currently renders only brawlers; `openArcade()` forces the upgrades tab back to brawlers, and `index.html` exposes only the BRAWLERS tab.
- `unlockCharacter()` grants characters without checking coin balance; character costs are 0–500.
- `matchEarnings` is initialized and shown at match end, but no code currently awards earnings or updates `profile.stats.coins`.
- Upgrades and trophy card styles/data already exist.
